description: Search named cities, counties, school systems and special districts in Election.org's Census-based public-body directory. Returns source-backed institution records, available office contacts and enriched coverage, with record links. Similar names can refer to different jurisdictions. Directory inclusion does not establish current officials or exact service boundaries. Does not locate a user's home or provide private personal contacts.

q.description: A distinctive partial institution name, e.g. Bethel Township Municipal. Search matches consecutive text; shorten the query if punctuation or parenthetical words cause no matches.

state.description: Two-letter state or territory code of the public records being researched, not the user's location.

name: search_governments
title: Find local government and school-system records
